follow-up time: until serum β-hCG returned to normal range and menstrual recovery after hospital release
exposure: uterine artery embolization (UAE) followed by suction curettage
pituitrin injection coupled with hysteroscopy and suction curettage
outcome: time when serum β-hCG returned to normal range
menstrual recovery time after hospital release
cohort: 190 patients with type I cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
finding: While both uterine artery embolization (UAE) and pituitrin injection followed by hysteroscopic suction curettage are good choices for type I CSP treatment, pituitrin injection with hysteroscopic suction curettage resulted in shorter postoperative vaginal bleeding, postoperative hospitalization, overall hospitalization length, and lower overall hospitalization costs and rate of adverse events.
